heading: AMD joins $1 trillion club as shares surge over 180% in 2026 — what’s driving the chipmaker’s massive rally?
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Advanced Micro Devices shares surged 10% to a record $616, entering the $1 trillion market-cap club. Its rally reflects renewed optimism in chip stocks amid declining energy prices and rising demand for AI products, despite concerns over inflation and competition from Nvidia.
